lines.t: Verse 1:
I see them passing by, looking the other way,
How they turn from the love You freely planned.
You gave it all, every breath, every drop.
And though the world had turned away,
Your love for them hasn't stopped.
Pre-Chorus:
I lift my hands, I kneel and pray,
Hoping hearts will find the way.
Chorus:
It breaks my heart, brings tears to my eyes,
The way that they despise You.
You have done so much for them,
You have always loved them.
It saddens me to see Your children
Running away from their true home,
They think it’s better off alone.
Verse 2:
Through storms and trials I've gone through
You’ve been so near.
Yet so many in the world live in doubt and fear.
Your mercy flows, Your light so true,
Why can’t they see what I see in You?
Bridge:
Oh, Your treasure treat You as if You’re gone,
They forget the love You’ve carried all along.
The One who gave everything to save,
Yet they ignore the path You pave.
Chorus (repeat):
It breaks my heart, brings tears to my eyes,
The way that they despise You.
You have done so much for them,
You have always loved them.
It saddens me to see Your children
Running away from their true home,
They think it’s better off alone.
Final Chorus:
It breaks my heart, brings tears to my eyes,
The way that they despise You.
You gave Your life, the greatest gift,
Though they turned away, You gave it all for them.
I will always follow You,
And it saddens me that this world doesn’t too.
